paired.interpretation: fixed-outcome target differences and prospective expected differences are separate; current gain_raw has fixed source/action, while C2 immediate reads R and continuation reads the R-dependent decision mean; a shared head may learn a marginal mean, not every random return
paired.scope: production score_state local finite-U; frozen program weights/scope; not full organization intervention
paired.query_fit: score_scope excludes each query identity from its own fit before and after U
paired.expected_role: prospective quadrature estimate, never a real training label

incoming.momentum_scope: no reconstructed historical P; observed replay uses actual source/action and current coordinates
incoming.outcome_role: real observed label, used only after pre-revision predictions
